decision_principles: Assess sensitivity and specificity together, considering both absolute levels and their gap.
A small gap is not sufficient when both class-specific performances are poor.
Use MCC and ROC-AUC as complementary evidence; never declare a model good because one metric is high.
Do not hide the sensitivity-specificity trade-off, low-performing class, or confusion counts.
Compare the same cohort, positive-class definition, threshold, grouping and evaluation splits.
Report repeated-evaluation mean and SD; SD is not a confidence interval or evidence of statistical superiority.
No automatic model replacement or acceptance threshold has been specified. Choose thresholds using training/inner validation only, never by optimizing the reported held-out results.
current_candidate_ranking_threshold: 0.8 is an exploratory uncalibrated candidate score filter, not the threshold used for the classification metrics here
regression_scope: Sensitivity, specificity, MCC and ROC-AUC do not apply directly to continuous viscosity/turbidity. Keep regression error metrics separate; do not create post-hoc binary outcomes to force these metrics.
current_work: Re-report stored out-of-fold predictions only; no refit, threshold tuning or candidate prediction
